title: XXI Días Diptych
description: Diptych collage presented as two framed panels side by side, both densely layered with paper fragments, targets, concentric rings, chess pieces, warplane silhouettes, and fabric lettering. Left panel bears the inscription 'XXXI Días'; right panel includes text 'FOOTBALL', 'ADRIANE', and 'END', with scattered American football and bullseye motifs throughout.
composition: dense diptych with layered fragments and text
